evidence.quoted_text:
atomic_bytes(root / CONFIG, data)
        atomic_bytes(root / 'apps/crq-python/state/runner-disabled', b'Prepared inert; owner approval required to start.\n')
evidence.reason: At the current tip, prepare() writes the rendered live configuration at line 699 before creating the runner-disabled marker at line 700. A crash between those two atomic writes leaves the new configuration live without the marker when no marker pre-existed. Since prepare() only checks inactive state and an enabled but stopped timer is accepted, the tick path guarded by the marker can run the new configuration without owner approval. Writing the marker first preserves the intended inert state on a crash before the configuration write.
